name: Whitby Jet
desc: Polished black stone from the Yorkshire coast. Some creatures find it irresistible.

name: Slate Shard
desc: A sliver of Welsh slate, sharp enough to split a rock. Something in Llanberis has been waiting for one for a very long time.

name: Connemara Marble
desc: Green-veined marble from the Connemara hills. Reserved for a creature that has not yet decided what it wants to become.
